title: Set a direction people can follow
text: Turn big ambitions into a clear, staged plan so teams, funders and clinicians know what comes next and why.

title: Keep patients safe as you go digital
text: Learn how to spot and reduce the risks new technology can bring, so changes help people and never quietly harm them.

title: Build services everyone can use
text: Find out how to include people who are older, disabled, offline or less confident, so no one is left behind.

title: Design services people actually want
text: See what makes an online service for patients and citizens easy, trusted and worth coming back to.

title: Show that the change was worth it
text: Learn to define and track the benefits you promised, so you can prove value to funders and learn what really worked.

title: Help people adopt new ways of working
text: Discover how to bring staff and patients with you, so new systems are used well rather than ignored or worked around.
